# Tell users when they discard an unsaved draft

## What & Why
The draft notice can be dismissed with Discard, but that action is not announced through the existing live status regions. Users who rely on announcements should receive confirmation that the draft was intentionally discarded.

## Done looks like
- Discarding an answer draft announces that it was discarded without implying it was saved
- Discarding an opportunity draft announces the same outcome
- Browser coverage verifies both announcements
